answer: We implement a zero-knowledge verifiable delay primitive where validator collateral undergoes quadratic slashing. A minor perturbation, or zephyr, in consensus honesty triggers a cascade of liquidity erosion, converting staked assets into a punitive gale of burns. Because marginal attack costs scale super-linearly, the capital expenditure required to manipulate consensus always exceeds any extractable value. Grounding incentives in an ocean of locked assets guarantees a Nash equilibrium with negative expected attack utility.
